chestcount.registered: Chest registered! Open it normally to synchronize items.
chestcount.registered_already: Chest already registered. Use /chestcount info, rename or remove.
chestcount.unsafe_menu: Synchronization skipped: this server may replace chest menus. See trustedServers in config.json.
chestcount.not_ready: Join a world and wait for local data to load.
